scope: One-source spiritual successor or exactly-three-source original coherent game synthesis under existing Jeeves game generation owner
default: Original large top-down adventure with authored Zelda/NES adventure, Pokemon/GB fishing and Harvest Moon/SNES farming analog references. No user ROM, original assets or measured original-game behavior is claimed.
composition: Distinct exact source origins, normalized influence weights, actual style preservation strengths, explicit mechanic priorities and confidence-labelled conflict decisions compile original world geometry, shared original sprite atlas, analytic reachable routes, experience graph and coherent adventure/fishing/farming economy.
optimization: Bounded parameter candidates are evaluated through actual same-runtime transitions on fixed selection seeds and separate held-out seeds. Report actual counters, metrics, budgets, before/after and algorithm identity; authored preferences never fabricate reward or success.
authority: Application source owner must authorize every non-original source before generation and workload publication; source withdrawal blocks new compile/optimization admission. Output lineage cannot grant source rights or production promotion.
failure: Wrong source cardinality, duplicate origin, unknown priorities, nonfinite/unbounded mechanics, inconsistent lineage and failed native simulation reject. Portable source emission is not a successful desktop build receipt.
asset_scope: Original deterministic 128x128 RGBA sprite atlas consumed by browser/native/Python renderers; no source sprites, ROM bytes, image crops or music copies.

application_authoring_extension.authoring: Existing world.edit supports mutually exclusive complete changes or bounded typed set_field/upsert_entity/remove_entity/paint_terrain edits; all changes are materialized and validated by the canonical successor emitter before existing revision/source-authority CAS publication.
application_authoring_extension.inspection: Current exact world/source identities with editable sections, bounded field/entity/terrain paging and actual runtime action descriptor. Model projections omit generated source bodies and remain bounded.
application_authoring_extension.adoption: Exact owned completed goal-issued successor candidate, expected project version, original source/teacher authority and existing successor-adopt prepared save; registration grants no implicit owner conversion.
application_authoring_extension.exports: Existing source project JSON and digest-verified actual completed desktop binary downloads; candidate export is prepared lineage/source JSON only and never a build or download claim.
application_authoring_extension.compatibility: Legacy changes requests retain their body identity by omitting absent new fields; no rewriting of frozen commands, journals or receipts.
application_authoring_extension.playback: Expose the existing typed PlayRequest to canonical agent discovery; host forces admitted-policy AI control and <=256 steps. Studio result projections omit private human control tokens. Native/user controls retain their original direct API.
application_authoring_extension.source_roots: Studio/studio_rules source owners cannot implicitly convert to successor: admission rejects before creating any prepared editor operation. Existing original worlds and ordinary non-console bases retain supported adoption. Origins and source/teacher rights remain checked.
